patterns.note: Asymmetric grid layouts for content sections, often pairing a large image with text, creating dynamic visual interest.
Hero elements (logo, tagline, and 3D rendered private jet) parallax against the background sky as the user scrolls, with the jet moving at a slower rate.
The primary navigation bar transforms into a compact, sticky version with a solid dark background after the initial scroll, maintaining brand presence.
A dominant dark background is contrasted with warm earthy tones and cool blues for accents and imagery, creating a sophisticated and luxurious feel.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero image featuring a large, semi-transparent brand logo and tagline, where a prominent 3D rendered private jet is positioned to parallax against the background on scroll.
Uses scroll-triggered animations to reveal content sections, where elements slide or fade into view with a subtle delay as they enter the viewport.
The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent, full-height state to a compact, sticky bar with a solid dark background and reduced padding upon scrolling past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, modern feel. Body text is legible and well-spaced.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and image corners have a slight rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and openness.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a 3D rendered private jet in the hero, which subtly parallaxes against a dynamic sky background, immediately conveys a sense of luxury and advanced technology. This, combined with the sophisticated dark theme and warm accents, creates a premium and aspirational brand image.
